# CyteArc

> Out-of-core, provenance-backed single-cell analysis for RNA, ATAC, protein, and matched multi-omic data. Follow the linked documentation for the installed release. Do not infer unsupported methods or biological conclusions.

- [Home](./): choose a first example or find a guide for your analysis

## Getting started

- [Quick start](quickstart/): inspect a prepared analysis of 100,000 Tabula Sapiens cells, then run the RNA pipeline
- [Remote dataset mounting](tutorials/remote-stores/): plot the Tabula Sapiens atlas, save a local cell selection, and reopen it while counts stay remote
- [Installation](installation/): supported Python versions and installation paths

## scRNA-seq analysis

- [PBMC analysis](tutorials/scrna-seq/): interpret a prepared PBMC run with marker evidence
- [Quality control](tutorials/quality-control/): modality-aware and sample-aware filtering
- [Highly variable genes](tutorials/feature-selection/): feature-set diagnostics
- [Dimensionality reduction](tutorials/dimensionality-reduction/): PCA dimensions and layout comparison
- [Neighborhood graph](tutorials/graph-construction/): granular normalization, reduction, neighbours, and graphs
- [Clustering](tutorials/clustering/): Leiden, Paris, stability, connectivity, and markers
- [Analysis reuse](tutorials/reuse-and-tracing/): change the neighbour count without rerunning normalization, PCA, or the search index
- [Cell type annotation](tutorials/annotation/): marker interpretation and label assignment
- [Gene-set scoring](tutorials/gene-set-scoring/): AUCell and WAGGR activity scores
- [Cell-cycle scoring](tutorials/cell-cycle/): canonical phase scoring
- [Visualization](tutorials/plotting/): embedding, marker, hierarchy, and trajectory displays
- [Imputation](tutorials/imputation/): graph diffusion for exploratory visualization

## scATAC-seq and multimodal

- [scATAC-seq](tutorials/scatac-seq/): peak filtering, LSI, graph construction, clustering, and gene scores
- [CITE-seq](tutorials/cite-seq/): matched RNA and ADT analysis with WNN integration
- [TEA-seq](tutorials/tea-seq/): prepared RNA, ATAC, and protein analysis with three-way WNN
- [WNN and SNN integration](tutorials/multimodal-diagnostics/): compare SNN and WNN and inspect modality weights
- [HTO demultiplexing](tutorials/hto-demultiplexing/): sample-tag classification and Seurat comparison

## Integration and mapping

- [Dataset merging](tutorials/dataset-merging/): compatible stores and an uncorrected joint baseline
- [Harmony batch correction](tutorials/batch-correction/): Harmony, batch mixing, and biological conservation
- [Reference mapping and label transfer](tutorials/mapping-and-label-transfer/): fixed-reference projection

## Differential expression

- [Donor-level comparisons](tutorials/condition-comparisons/): matched donor-level testing and its limits
- [Pseudobulk export](tutorials/pseudobulk-and-differential-expression/): biological-replicate aggregation and export

## Trajectory analysis

- [Pseudotime](tutorials/pseudotime/): supervised sources and sinks
- [Expression dynamics](tutorials/expression-dynamics/): feature profiles and modules
- [Fate mapping](tutorials/fate-mapping/): multiple terminal outcomes
- [Trajectory validation](tutorials/trajectory-validation/): boundary, graph, statistical, and numerical checks

## Data management

- [Import and export](tutorials/import-and-export/): source formats, saved Seurat import, and output contracts
- [Scanpy users](scanpy/): workflow mapping and H5AD exchange
- [Seurat users](seurat/): workflow mapping, RDS import, and WNN differences
- [Data model comparison](scanpy-and-seurat/): how objects, selections, and saved results differ between tools
- [Cell and feature metadata](tutorials/data-organization/): assays, cell data, feature data, and metadata
- [Provenance](concepts/provenance/): artifacts, reuse, lineage, and limits
- [Custom analyses](tutorials/custom-analyses/): public extension and export boundaries

## Public datasets

- [CyteBase catalog](tutorials/cytebase/): search cloud-hosted datasets, inspect annotations, and mount a published store
- [COVID-19 atlas case study](tutorials/cytebase-covid19/): compare donors using metadata, the published UMAP, and gene summaries

## Reference

- [API reference](api/index.html): exact public signatures and result contracts
- [Memory and execution](concepts/memory-and-execution/): choose budgets and workers, inspect run reports, and understand memory reservations
- [Remote storage configuration](reference/remote-storage/): object-store credentials, mount behavior, and scratch space for reductions
- [Methods and limitations](reference/methods/): supported workflows, implemented methods, validation evidence, and scope
- [FAQ](reference/faq/): concise method and interoperability answers
- [Glossary](reference/glossary/): CyteArc concepts and terms
- [CyteBase API](api/cytebase.html): catalog queries, metadata-only DatasetEntry objects, remote DataStore access, imported embedding helpers, and writable mounts with remote counts

## Developers

- [Contributing](developers/contributing/): local workflow and required checks
- [Architecture](developers/architecture/): package boundaries and code placement
- [Zarr internals](developers/zarr-internals/): on-disk layout for maintainers
- [Operation revisions](developers/operation-revisions/): maintainer rules for invalidating saved computations after algorithm changes
